source.note: Synthetic OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest payloads. LiteLLM stock cases reconstruct the allowlisted emitted-usage projection of the pinned local mock-provider captures; provenance variants add the expected source assertions. They do not claim that the live callback supports streaming. All other cases are hand-specified accounting vectors.

notes: The slice key is absent from every input so all counted spans share one global slice.
Usage and operation classification read span attributes only. Default user/prompt/doc mappings can fall back to resources; default session mapping cannot. Scope attributes are not inherited.
Observation states overlap: reported can coexist with invalid, conflict, or subset_violation. Missing applies only to input/output. Provenance declarations are assertions, not authenticated origin.
Token subsets remain subsets, never additions to input/output totals. Explicit unavailable suppresses the parent count but does not erase independently reported subset counts.

Expected maps are complete for successful cases, including zeros. observed_counters defaults to metrics when omitted; when present it is the complete exact uint64 counter map before metric samples are clamped to int64. Error cases have empty expected maps and require an error, not a partial success report; receiver state after batch failure is outside this contract.
Per-span values/sums and top-k weights have an int64 ceiling. Cumulative slice counters reject uint64 overflow; this is distinct from the int64 ceiling of exported metric samples.
